test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 23 Jan 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the third term in the same way as the second term is related to the first term.

APTITUDE : BQUJUVEF :: ANALOGY : ?
solution:
Here, we use the table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0489088f1b62b10bec5ff2825f26f6db4ad8e2425ea6ba78b4d9fbf3900b189e.png] 

**Logic:** 'Addition of (1) to the positional value of each alphabet'

APTITUDE : BQUJUVEF →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51fcc58ba2642565fed1035a9b1c76090770b1fc274eb8c40e8302230b28234b.png] 

Similarly, 'ANALOGY' will be written as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/994eac7a9a1a611a48ca229825abd45bfcfb81756f478e3b798dd10d94867029.png] 

Here, 'ANALOGY' is written as** 'BOBMPHZ'.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (2)".
